				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Wing and Kite surfers have found their paradise in Brazil!</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8a1e616 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8a1e616" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;none&quot;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The whole bay of Icarai lends itself wonderfully well to kiteboarding. Cross and one-shore wind direction provides perfect safe conditions.</p><p>The NE trade winds blow there all year round. Maximum intensity from August to November with an average wind above 25 kn.</p><p>Forget your big kites….</p><p>Huge possibilities for up and downwinders with everything from fun waves, flat lagoons and spacious safe bays to enjoy.</p><p><strong>WING:</strong> the perfect place to be for learning and progression. We have devoted a dedicated space for rigging, launching and landing.equipment. Equipment storage, lessons and rental are available.</p><p>Around the Kombi-bar and the video screen, you can debrief at sunset in a warm and friendly atmosphere.</p>								</div>
